purpose: Optional local acceleration profile; scientific authority remains durable Drive/Library/GitHub state.
implementation_rules: Process one month per heavyweight worker and checkpoint before aggregation.
Stream/chunk gzip CSV; do not materialize the full Jan-Jul corpus in pandas.
Convert required columns to compact NumPy arrays immediately.
Use Numba for inner tick traversal and keep pandas/groupby out of tick loops.
Reuse precomputed event indices/features instead of rescanning ticks for every parameter.
Avoid repeated decompression; cache only compact derived artifacts when disk headroom permits.
Do not run more than one heavyweight research worker while MT5 and Chrome are active.
Narrative/UI progress is non-authoritative until a validated artifact manifest exists.
